title: A sufficient home among caring possibilities

captions.physics: Keeping thoughtfully chosen essentials at home
captions.energy: Multiplying care beyond a sufficient measure
captions.emotions: Experiencing wholeness in shared domestic space

meaning: Your domestic arrangements gain wholeness when thoughtful selection acknowledges enough without surrendering finished space to endless additions of convenience.
text: You can create support through meaningful choice: noticing genuine need, considering experience and keeping what is useful. The Hermit in the physical position of Muladhara describes these actions. The Empress in energy complicates them through excessive care that continually finds another addition. The World in emotions wants wholeness in your shared home. Completion recedes when every free space seems an unused opportunity. Before a finished arrangement can be enjoyed, another compulsory degree of comfort for two has already been assigned to it.

For example, you arrange a comfortable place for evening tea. Additional shelves, containers and spare cups soon appear, although the earlier arrangement was sufficient. **Free space can also belong to a completed sense of comfort.** Choosing enough does not reject the wish to care. It allows you to see and use the whole picture without repeatedly yielding space to a useful new object merely because an appealing application has been found for it.

The difficulty is treating wholeness as a promise to accommodate everything good. Additions multiply while home feels less finished. Thoughtfully distinguishing the needed from the possible offers more support. An object can be useful in itself without being required by your routine. Experience then protects sufficiency, while care is measured through ease of living rather than the number of ideas implemented.
